reading: The City of Searcy, Arkansas operates a municipal government data center and network operations center out of its Information Technology Building at 107 North Elm Street, supporting internal city department operations rather than offering commercial or resident-facing services. The facility includes a 24-hour network operations center with remote environmental monitoring, offsite fiber-connected backup, and a natural gas or propane Generac generator for power redundancy, alongside fiber connections linking all city department buildings over Cisco networking equipment. The IT department maintains six storage arrays totaling 210 terabytes with fully automated daily backups and runs a Cisco Enterprise IP Telephony system supporting more than 150 desktop phones citywide. No evidence was found of a municipal broadband program extending city network or internet service to residents or local businesses, distinguishing this facility from municipally owned broadband utilities in some other US cities. Searcy's infrastructure appears to exist solely to support the city government's own departments and employee training programs.
